translated_texts: Good morning, Alex Moreno, thanks for making time. Today is about the workshop next semester.
Gladly. I have already collected a few ideas, mainly about the schedule.
How many participants are you expecting?
I expect around thirty people from different departments.
That is a good size. Do we need a bigger room for that?
Yes, the seminar room in the main building is not enough. I would ask for the lecture hall.
Good, then I will take care of the room booking. How long should the workshop last?
I am thinking of a whole day, with a morning for talks and an afternoon for group work.
And who gives the talks?
Two people from computer science have already said yes. A third contribution is still open.
Then we should send out an invitation soon so that everyone keeps the date free.
Agreed. I will draft the text by the end of the week.
Wonderful. Then let me summarize: book the room, send the invitation, set the program.
Exactly, and next week we meet once more to agree on the program.

de.title: Workshop-Planung (Beispiel)
de.summary: Kim Berger und Alex Moreno planen einen eintägigen Workshop im nächsten Semester mit etwa dreißig Teilnehmenden. Vormittags sind Vorträge vorgesehen, nachmittags Gruppenarbeit. Der Hörsaal soll gebucht, die Einladung bis Ende der Woche entworfen und das Programm in der Folgewoche abgestimmt werden.
de.refinement_summary: Zeichensetzung korrigiert, Füllwort entfernt und ein getrenntes Wort zusammengeschrieben.
